body.name: Quantized randomized-response channel
body.construction: Compute \(T_{2,k}=\mathbf 1\{\mathcal E_{\mathrm{coll}}\}(U_1V_2+V_1U_2)/2\); set \(\sigma_{2,k}\) to its sign, using an independent fair Rademacher tie-break when \(T_{2,k}=0\); report \(RR_{2,k}=\sigma_{2,k}\) with probability \(e^\epsilon/(1+e^\epsilon)\) and its negative otherwise; and set \(\widehat\theta_{\mathrm{RR}}=-RR_{2,k}ab/(1/4-a^2)\).
